summary.text: Alan Morgan is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives who represents District 18, having assumed office on June 15, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner, and notes that the Republican primary for his seat was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Morgan lives in Greer, South Carolina, and earned a B.S. in business administration from Bob Jones University in 2010.

His career experience, according to Ballotpedia, includes co-owning a business and working as a senior corporate trainer with Shellpoint Mortgage Servicing, a service operations manager with Quantros, and a salesforce administrator and data analyst with Polydeck.
He succeeded Tommy Stringer in the seat and is assigned to the Agriculture, Natural Resources and Environmental Affairs Committee in the 2025-2026 session.
